quest.title: Says He Who Seeks Stone
quest.description: Help Muning to complete Huishan Hall's bounty and find Archaic Stone distributed throughout The Chasm's upper levels...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Archaic Stone... *sigh* In all the years I've worked in The Chasm, I've barely seen even one. What are the big shots at Huishan Hall thinking...

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Let them do the job and they'll know how impossible the task is.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Muning—!

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. Why are you still wandering on the upper levels of The Chasm?

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Um... Don't get me wrong. It's not that I don't welcome you here. I just wonder... Uh, don't you have other important matters to attend to?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph, we were just kindly dropping by to check up on you, since you looked so troubled...

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: *sigh*... Do you know about Archaic Stone?

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: It's a rare ore — so rare that you won't even necessarily find one in the mines. I've only seen two or three such stones for all my years here at The Chasm. It's such a gorgeous gemstone with beauty beyond imagination.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: They say that if you look inside the finest Archaic Stones, you'll see shimmering light rays as thin as hair, and that the stones' color reminds you of the sea horizon in the twilight...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Do you mean a stone like this?

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Ah, you... you actually have one! And it's of the highest quality that I've ever seen, too!

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, how about you sell this stone to me?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep! It's a gift from a friend...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Besides, Paimon seriously doubts if your pocket is thick enough to afford the hole this stone is gonna burn through.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Well... I've got a buyer behind me, so finances aren't exactly the problem.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A buyer?

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Yes. Somehow, the big shots at Huishan Hall got interested in the stone and wanted to analyze it, so they sent me to The Chasm to look for a few samples.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: But I'm busy getting my job over with... ahem... I mean, doing my job.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: #How about we make a deal, {NICKNAME}? If you find any Archaic Stones, bring them to me. In exchange, the reward promised by Huishan Hall will be yours.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: They don't have to match the quality of yours, as long as they are Archaic Stones.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Rewards from Huishan Hall!

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Normally, I would handle the job myself, but my hands have been tied by various affairs here in The Chasm lately, so please help me with this.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: *sigh* ...That said, I'm not sure how many they want. How about you bring me three for starters?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, alright, we got it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So what you're trying to say is that you are looking for some stones of beautiful colors?

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Not all stones of beautiful colors will do. It has to be THE stone.

response.speaker: Muning

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: These are indeed Archaic Stones. You have my thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: I was right to come to you. I bet it would've taken much longer if it'd been the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... who knows. Perhaps, the Adventurers' Guild might even...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Send us the commission.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: That's quite likely.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Adventurers... Hmm... I used to be envious of them. The way they ventured into high mountains and deep dungeons... There seemed to be nowhere they dared not go.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: I'm quite the opposite though — I've been working here for years but haven't once visited Cinnabar Cliff on the very top of The Chasm.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? You haven't been there even once?

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Well, Cinnabar Cliff is one of those famous tourist spots that locals seldom go to.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Maybe it's so close that I always think that I can visit it later when I've got time — but well, I've never "got time."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then, why don't we go now?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's important to act spontaneously.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: I think I'll pass. I'm still in the middle of something.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: What's more, such errand-running is best left to adventurers.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Dangerous places are their bread and butter, after all. I'd probably get injured if I did the same, and that's something I'd like to avoid.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Makes sense. Getting injured could be a big deal.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: If I'm injured, no one's gonna supervise the exploration team down there and ensure the safety of the miners.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Should anything happen, it will escalate into a grievous matter.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's what you're worried about... Paimon thought you were just scared of getting injured!

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: The formidably high cliffs near The Chasm, the bottomless caves... and the ancient battlefield left behind by Rex Lapis are all full of danger...

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: I don't have the slightest interest in venturing into those places.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Here, the rewards for the three Archaic Stones. Huishan Hall wants quite a lot of them, so bring me more if you can find any.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Of course, there will be rewards for those, too. Just remember to come to me once you find more Archaic Stones.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You can count on us!

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Three more.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: I shall gratefully take the Archaic Stones submitted by our two "civic-minded citizens."

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: I didn't expect you to find two of them so quickly. And they are much better in quality than the ones I've previously seen.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: *sigh*... They remind me of the one that I used to have.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You have an Archaic Stone?

choices.text: Then why send us to look for it?

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: I mean I USED to have one.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: My old man once handled a batch of ores at Shenglu Hall. That stone was just a leftover remnant and its quality was poor, so he gave it to me as a toy.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: We had been arguing all the time back then. I never had a job. And to make it worse, I spent most of my time at Yanshang Teahouse. As such, I ended up in heavy debt — and in distress too...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That feels a bit wrong...

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Well, who hasn't done a stupid thing or two when they were young? Anyway, when I was helpless...

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Someone recognized my Archaic Stone and offered a good price. To me, it was no big deal — a stone in exchange for some Mora to get me out of my immediate predicament. A fair trade I'd say.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Yet my father brought this up the other day and asked, "Muning, where did you put the stone that I gave you?"

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: All I could tell him was, "It's just a stone. I've long lost it."

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Though I said so, I couldn't help wondering what if I hadn't sold the stone — then I could show it to Father when he mentioned it...

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: ...Forget it. It's no use wondering about the what-if now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: At least the prodigal son has returned.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: You are right... It's just that I still have a long way to go before I can clear my debt.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: I've digressed. Do bring me the stones if you find more.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Hmm... Bring me three more. Three more would be enough.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Archaic Stone is a rare ore. If Huishan Hall wants more, I seriously doubt if I can find any here in The Chasm.

choices.text: Just how many do you need?

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: With these three included, it's nine in total. They should be enough.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: You managed to gather what Huishan Hall needs so quickly. No wonder they speak so highly of you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh, it was easy! Easy-peasy, lemon-breezy!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm sure it's "lemon-squeezy," Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Uh, well, lemons can be breezy too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, look at you, forcing your logic through. Most impressive.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Haha... We've all witnessed your heroic deeds of fighting the sea monster. I believe it was no challenge for you to accomplish such a feat.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Well, so much for being a Ministry staff member. They still ask you to do things like "look for Archaic Stone in The Chasm"...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of which, you said you often argued with your father back then and didn't have a job.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then how did you make it into the Ministry later?

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: You know how I owed a big sum at the time? I could turn to no one, nor was I willing to go home.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: In the end, the debt collectors came looking for my old man at the Shenglu Hall... I thought he'd come find me to break my legs upon hearing the news.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But your legs look fine.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Yes... It's embarrassing to say, but he cleared my debt and came looking for me. By the time he found me, I was almost like a beaten-up dog on the street. He said, "I have all your IOUs, so now you're indebted to me."

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: With that, he forced me to work — to pay my debt.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So your father is your creditor now.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: You can say that...

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Back then, with the debt collectors after me, I couldn't even fall asleep at night. So, I swore that I'd mend my ways if I was given a second chance.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: But I didn't expect the chance to come from my father, who always disapproved of my behaviors...

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: He didn't lash out at me as usual. Instead, we had a talk — an honest and sincere one. How I wish we could've talked this way earlier.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: But even if he'd been open for a talk, I wouldn't have been willing to listen.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Looks like your father treats you well.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Yeah.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: So I have to get my job done well under whatever circumstances.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Whether it's the incident in The Chasm or looking for Archaic Stones for Huishan Hall.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I believe I'm the one who did the job for you this time...

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Having people get the job done also counts.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: But still, it's all thanks to you that we moved swimmingly — I'd say it was way more quickly than I expected.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, Paimon finally senses a touch of gratitude there.

choices.text: It's actually a bit of a challenge...

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Have you found the Archaic Stones?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here they are.
